normalization: ability anchor in original index points; recent/condition residual divided by 10 and clipped to [-1,1]; all auxiliary features bounded [-1,1]; missing component contributes zero with missing flag, not a fabricated observation

rationale.ability: Preserve original pure ability as anchor; do not start from official Top5 with existing bonuses.
rationale.recent_form: Use trend residual (last index minus earlier mean), not the recent mean already present in pure ability.
rationale.class: Previous/current transition and field-normalized finish combined only for comparable classes; historical best experience is audit only.
rationale.condition: Use matched recent index residual relative to other recent indices, not another copy of distance/course/star level; require surface/venue/distance/turn evidence.
rationale.pace: Interaction between provider pace, front-runner count and exact predicted corner4; no unconditional corner4 bonus copied from formal Top5.
rationale.training: Bounded JRA-only auxiliary term; no invented NAR training.
rationale.jockey: Only explicit course place rate with at least 20 starts; switch is factual audit, not automatic upgrade.
rationale.weight: Record actual weight/change for future validation; no unvalidated lighter-is-better points.
